name: Sub-macro (target-head) leverage diagnostic (SMLD) -- does target selection carry the payoff loss macro choice cannot explain?
authority: PI, 2026-09-04: run the z1 sub-macro diagnostic in parallel as a CHEAP diagnostic, not as another prerequisite that traps the program in a diagnostic tunnel. The sharing ladder remains the designated main scientific successor and is not blocked on this.

THE_FINDING_THAT_MOTIVATES_THIS.computed_from_existing_data_at_zero_gpu_: DLD_PASS1_RECORD_V2.json already stored the FULL action vector (student, pi_A, pi_B) at every decision state. The frozen DLD mismatch definition examined only the MACRO head; the target head was recorded but never analysed.
THE_FINDING_THAT_MOTIVATES_THIS.action_space: MultiDiscrete([5, 50, 5, 50]) -- per agent a 5-way MACRO and a 50-way TARGET. Indices 0,2 are macros; indices 1,3 are targets.
THE_FINDING_THAT_MOTIVATES_THIS.why_this_matters: the student agrees with its teacher on WHAT to do far more reliably than on WHICH TARGET. DLD searched the macro head and found z1 had only 7 mismatches in 3,067 decision steps -- too few to branch on. At the target head z1 has 49, which is enough. The macro-level null result for z0 (DLD_RESULT_BY_LATENT_ADDENDUM.json) says nothing about the target head, which was never tested.
THE_FINDING_THAT_MOTIVATES_THIS.power_consequence: z1 becomes testable. This diagnostic is the correctly-aimed version of DLD, not a rescue of it: DLD's z0 macro conclusion stands unchanged and is not revisited.

DESIGN.reuses_unchanged: experiments/dld_pass2_branch.py's branching machinery: rebuild env at the same seed/pole, replay the student prefix via replay_prefix (asserts live agreement, refuses on divergence), seed core._rng identically across both branches, run BRANCH_S (student action) and BRANCH_T (counterfactual) to episode end under the student policy so only the single decision differs.
DESIGN.the_one_change: selection and counterfactual operate on the TARGET head instead of the MACRO head.
DESIGN.mismatch_definition: a decision-bearing step where the LATENT-matched teacher's argmax TARGET differs from the student's argmax target on at least one agent free to commit (z0 -> pi_A, z1 -> pi_B, either pole), REGARDLESS of whether the macro agrees
DESIGN.counterfactual_at_mismatch: the latent-matched teacher's FULL action vector for that agent (macro and target together). Substituting the target alone while keeping a macro the teacher did not intend could create an incoherent pair the teacher would never emit; the teacher's own joint choice is the meaningful counterfactual.
DESIGN.counterfactual_at_agreement_reference: the student's own runner-up legal TARGET for the agent with the largest runner-up mass, macro unchanged. Same decision-sensitivity-reference status as in DLD -- NOT a matched control, and DLD_TERMINOLOGY_AND_LICENSED_READING_AMENDMENT.json's naming and licensed-reading constraints carry over verbatim.
DESIGN.data_source: DLD_PASS1_RECORD_V2.json shards -- no new rollouts for selection; only the branch rollouts cost GPU time

sampling.rule: the same deterministic evenly-spaced stride over the (episode, step)-sorted eligible pool; no RNG, no outcome inspection
sampling.shortfall_rule: take all available and record, per DLD_POWER_RESOLUTION_AMENDMENT.json

DESIGN.eligibility: unchanged from DLD: decision-bearing, step >= 5, >= 40 steps remaining before MAX_STEPS=240
DESIGN.device: cuda, matching DLD and the sealed evals
DESIGN.expected_branch_points: 40 mismatch (all four cells now have >= 10 target mismatches: z0@A 78, z0@B 81, z1@A 36, z1@B 13) + 40 agreement = 80, x2 rollouts each

QUANTITIES.reported: per latent SEPARATELY (z0, z1), each against zero and against its own agreement-arm |L_margin| decision-sensitivity reference
QUANTITIES.statistic: paired percentile bootstrap over branch points, n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7
QUANTITIES.IS_NOT_A_GATE: measurement only. Crossover remains the only scientific gate, and the frozen crossover result stays FAIL until a NEW checkpoint clears a FRESH sealed eval.

PREREGISTERED_READINGS.pattern: E[L | target mismatch] materially larger in magnitude than the agreement reference, for either latent
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.reading: target selection carries downstream consequence that macro choice does not -- the payoff attenuation lives below the macro layer. Successor candidate: distillation weighted toward target-head fidelity, or a target-head-specific loss term. Would require its own preregistration.

PREREGISTERED_READINGS.pattern: E[L | target mismatch] near zero or no larger than the reference, for both latents
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.reading: sub-macro action choice is also not the mechanism. Combined with DLD's macro null, action-level explanations are exhausted for z0 and z1 alike, and the parameter-sharing ladder becomes the only substantive remaining structural hypothesis.
report as-is without forcing a single story; the two latents may fail for different reasons, which is itself informative for the paper.

SEEDS: no new seeds. Selection reuses DLD_PASS1_RECORD_V2.json (block 11940001..11940032, non-sealed); branch rollouts are deterministic replays of those same episodes with one decision altered.
RELATION_TO_THE_LADDER: this does NOT gate SHARING_LADDER_SPEC.json. The ladder proceeds on its own schedule; this runs in parallel and only redirects effort if it uncovers a specific, directly repairable mechanism.
SEQUENCE: freeze this spec -> build the target-head selector/brancher on the DLD machinery -> run on cuda -> report per latent -> PI decides whether it redirects anything
